notes.title: Wacky's Funhouse / Scamper
notes.content:
Unlike the ghosts -Boo Men isn't dead! A long-awaited Spring update is here!

[h3]A New Map[/h3]
[h1]Wacky's Funhouse![/h1]
Your glowstick won't be of much use here, as neither will the lights! Wacky's Funhouse offers a brightly-lit environment with animated obstacles and fun to explore areas with no wrong turns!


[h3]A New Boo Man[/h3]
[h1]Scamper[/h1]
The skinless stalker who does not like to be seen! Scamper likes to sneak up on its victim when they aren't looking. Turn around too fast and it will be instant lights out! So keep your eyes down when running through the dark and don't look at anything looking back at you!
Oh, and one more thing to note; It is only seeable by the person it is stalking...


[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[list]
[*] 3 New Masks (all glow in the dark)
Cosmic (animated), Hypno (animated), Polka Dots
[*] Added tips upon death for new players who don't read the ghost guide
[*] Added some UI sounds to the main menu + updated load screen
[*] Fixed jumpscare sometimes showing the Scav no matter who killed you
[*] Fixed 'Close' button in Ghost Guide not showing on some monitor resolutions
[*] Other minor bug fixes and changes
[/list]

Additional [b]future[/b] updates in queue (not in order):
[list]
[*] End game stats page for multiplayer (and some for single player as well)
(# of items found per player, player revives, time spent in light/number of lights turned on, power outages, etc...)
[*] Better functioning server browser
[*] Arnie and Scamper in PvP
[*] Random weather effects (rain, thunder, lightning, clear)
[*] Additional Perks
[*] Leveling up system
[*] Extra environment paranormal events
[*] PvP Custom Settings
[/list]

There are some things that I may have missed, but just @ me on Discord or comment here if you have anything you would like to see in game! 
Thank you everyone for your continued support! A lot of efforts have been shifted to a new and upcoming project which is why updates have been further apart, but I still plan on continuing updates with Boo Men for a long time!
:) Happy Spring!

notes.title: Overhaul Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello boo-glars![/b]
As we approach spooky season, many quality of life changes and behind-the-scenes reworking needed to be done to pave way for future updates! This update took a lot longer than usual because the entire game needed to be restructured in order to pull it off + some efforts have shifted to a new and exciting project! 
This game will be seeing a lot of exciting updates in the near future, but for now [h2]this update brings you:[/h2]

[h3]Custom Game Mode[/h3]
Not only can you now completely customize your heist (and still get paid!), but you can also play against multiple boo men!

[h3]Nightmare Difficulty[/h3]
Same settings as insane, only now you are going up against 2 random boo men

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]Regular Changes:
[list]
[*]Random map option
[*]Reworked The Troll to where when he roars, there is a chance it will break the lights
[*]Moved 'Monster Mode' to the regular lobby so players can conveniently swap between modes
[*]Item finder doll is a lot more accurate
[*]Revive doll is a little better too I guess
[*]Players can now equip perks in the lobby
[*]Updated the client's lobby to see the host's selections[/list][/list][list]
[*]PvP:
[list]
[*]Added Cynthia to PvP
[*]Reworked The Troll to reflect changes to the actual Troll + you can now see players in the light when using your roar ability
[*]Boo Men no longer get a hint or notification when players are on the last item[/list][/list][list]
[*]Perks:
[list]
[*]Night Light: You get 3 flares instead of 1
[*]Seeker: Lasts 80 seconds (use to be 30) and get an auditory alert when you are near the item
[*]Lock Picker: Unlocking only takes 8-16 seconds (use to be 16-36)
[*]Goosebumps: Cooldown has been reduced from 12 seconds to 8 seconds.[/list][/list][list]
[*]Bugs + other minor changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Ghost Girl crashing the game after killing everyone
[*]Reduced Mimic's chase speed
[*]Lobby options save after each round
[*]Minor updates to regular mode difficulty payout and item quantity in multiplayer
[/list][/list]

notes.title: The Cynthia Update
notes.content:
[h1]Boo![/h1]
Happy [i]whateverdaythisupdatecomesout[/i] day! I am excited to share with you this big and fun update! There is a lot to explore, so here is the breakdown:

[list]
[h3][*]New Boo Man - Cynthia

[*]New Map (Small) - Cubicle Gardens[/h3]

[h3][*]Helper Dolls:[/h3]
Helper dolls will spawn under certain conditions (unless playing on insane) and will aid you in your heist!
[olist]
[*]The Voodoo Doll: When a burglar dies, a voodoo doll containing their soul will spawn somewhere on the map. If a living player interacts with this doll, it will revive that player (one per person).
[*]The Item Finder: This doll will spawn at the start of every heist, but should be saved for desperate times. Interact with this doll and it will -try its best- to lead you to a random, unfound item.
[*]The Breaker Doll: This doll will only appear during power outages (but in the same location each round). If you ever find yourself cornered and far away from the breaker, look for this glowing doll and he will take care of it for you!
[/olist]
[h3][*]Monster Mode:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Added Ghost Girl
[*]Made the Mimic slightly slower and added a cooldown for turning off the lights
[*]The Scav can hear players through walls
[*]Fixed Edith's ability not always working
[/olist]
[h3][*]Quality of Life + Other:[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Dead burglars can see other dead burglars as spoopy ghosts
[*]Added customization options for shirt color
[*]Light bulbs now actually glow for extra immersion
[*]Revamped tutorial
[*]Minor bug fixes that I will find out are not actually fixed two days from now
[/olist]
[/list]

Remember you can hop on down to the discord posted somewhere on the store page and add feedback as the game keeps evolving!
Thank you and keep stealing from old ladies!

[b]A new Boo Man was among us all along! 
Introducing... -who you thought was just Tim- ...The Mimic!
The Mimic can disguise as a player to travel through the light, but be weary of anyone running for the switch.[/b]

[h3]In this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Mimic
[*]Added a timer for those who want to speedrun*
[*]Keys now glow in the dark when you are near them
[*]The Troll now only glows when chasing after a player
[*]Fixed ghosts not being able to enter the cabins on Camp Suydam
[/list]

*The timer starts as soon as you drop into the level (swoosh sound effect) and will stop as soon as you touch the escape car!

I know this update took a long time and there are probably going to be some (hopefully only minor) bugs, but I will adjust the Mimic based on player feedback so nothing is currently set in stone! 
For the next update I will continue to fix bugs and possibly add some more stuff to the market, but I will be experimenting with a new fun map that will hopefully add some twists into the game...

You can @ me on discord or pm me because even though I read everything, I am bad at communicating.

-Twisted

[h2]Hello burglars![/h2]

[b]Thank you to everyone for contributing to the community and helping with feedback and issues! This is a status update on the near future of the game and why it has been a while since the last update.

To rip the band-aid off -I have been having a lot of issues running the project and UE4. My PC seems to be nearing its inevitable end as I am experiencing countless crashes each day and corrupted saves. I am hoping I can ride it out a bit longer with upgrades, but it has been delaying updates for the game.[/b]

[h3]The next update which I hope to have sometime in the next 2 weeks will include[/h3]

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[b]Current bugs I plan to fix over the course of the next several days:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removing broken achievements (temporarily)
[*]Head bob while spectating
[*]Issues with escaping if someone dies
[*]Sometimes only 7 items will spawn no matter the difficulty or player count
[*]Keeping the party together after each round
[*]Settings not loading correctly
[*]Players needing to sometimes restart the game in order to join servers
[*]Ghost glitching
[*]Door replication issues when opened by a ghost
[*]Lobby widgets overlapping 4th player
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[b]Gameplay changes I plan to update over the next several days:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased glow stick radius
[*]Increased FOV
[*]Reduce chance of spawning Edith
[*]Increase network bandwidth for 4-player games
[*]Increased outdoor visibility for Riverglen map
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[b]Gameplay features I plan to add over the next several days:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extra settings to include FOV slider, motion blur, and enable/disable head bob, VSync
[*]Drastically increase variety of items
[*]Reduce number of lights by 1 for each difficulty setting
[*]"The Leroy Estate" map will be free
[*]Adjustments made to the store pricing
[*]Reduce grace period
[*]Increase difficulty for 4-player games
[/list]

[h1]Down the road...[/h1]
[b]Future updates being discussed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Proximity Voice Chat
[*]More customization features (shirt color, glow stick color)
[*]Nightmare difficulty...
[*]More masks
[*]More maps
[*]More ghosts
[*]Holiday themed events
[*]Randomized breaker locations
[*]Add pins to the store which will grant perks
[/list]

I will add and remove from these lists as feedback grows and updates roll out! 
Thank you everyone for your input and feedback that will help the game grow as new content gets added!

:)
